decisions.reason: Schlager compilations draw directly on the label's long reissue experience and core German collector base, and back-catalog CDs normally stay listed in a warehouse-backed shop.
The illustrated series is a multi-title line built on the firm's curation and editorial know-how, so it can keep adding releases instead of being withdrawn.
Jazz vinyl reissues fit the firm's reissue expertise and its genre expansion, though limited pressings can sell out and leave the catalog.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature format for specialist reissue labels and hold long-term catalog value for collectors, despite some risk of limited editions going out of print.
A compilation CD costs little to keep in stock and matches existing competence, but its lower prominence on the website suggests weaker demand and a modest risk of deletion.
